result: No spill built (coordinator note on challenge #7189): issue #21's find gap is size-class rounding (257..272-byte FTSENTs in class 320, +6164 KiB), not nearby-size reuse; per-cause numbers for find, the issue probe and a class-shift workload in the handoff

rulings.item: find under issue #21's formula needs a size class for 257..272 bytes (find 4.11 allocates 200003 FTSENTs of that size; class 320 costs +6164 KiB; libniji is 3496..4552 KiB over the formula)
rulings.recommendation: new story HEAP-CLASS-272: add a 272 (or 288) class between 256 and 320; up to 4688 KiB less by arithmetic, which brings find under the formula

rulings.item: the spill still matters for the probe's refill step (+9668 KiB over the reference; target 33092) and class-shifting programs (+22272 KiB VmSize in phase 2 against the reference's 5412)
rulings.recommendation: keep HEAP-SPILL-COLD open after HEAP-CLASS-272; build it with refill returning the class (release bins within budget) and the lowbit alignment rule; 128->160 needs the request alignment, for which no cheap carrier was found

informational: target/niji/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2 runs only self-contained PIE programs; system binaries are measured by relinking their objects statically (the workload kit's method)
issue probe RLIMIT_AS need on next: fixed layout 41296 KiB, randomised 41296..43440 over 20 runs

impact.what: measurement study only: per-cause split of issue #21's address-space gap; no behaviour change

improvement: the brief rested on a premise (spill inside the cold grow function with byte-identical hot functions) that a 10-minute read of the call chain disproves; a brief for a heap change should name the return path its new logic needs
next_step: coordinator rules on HEAP-CLASS-272 and on keeping HEAP-SPILL-COLD open
